headlines.description: — Otto Lopez's two run homer capped a six-run ninth inning and the Miami Marlins rallied past the Washington Nationals 6-2 on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Lopez homer caps six-run ninth as Marlins rally past Nationals 6-2

events.name: Boston Red Sox at New York Yankees

headlines.description: — Austin Wells homered twice in a nine-run eighth inning, Heliot Ramos hit a three-run homer in the fifth and the New York Yankees widened their lead in the AL wild-card race and clinched the season series against the Boston Red Sox with a 16-1...
headlines.shortLinkText: Austin Wells homers twice in 9-run eighth, Heliot Ramos homers in fifth as Yankees rout Red Sox 16-1

headlines.description: — Matt Olson's single past first base drove in Brewer Hicklen with the winning run in the 10th inning and the Atlanta Braves recovered after losing an early lead to beat the Colorado Rockies 3-2 on Sunday for their seventh straight win.
headlines.shortLinkText: Olson delivers walk-off single in 10th as Braves outlast Rockies 3-2 for 7th consecutive win

events.name: Seattle Mariners at Toronto Blue Jays

headlines.description: — Max Scherzer and two relievers combined on a one-hitter, Alejandro Kirk and Kazuma Okamoto homered and the Toronto Blue Jays thumped the Seattle Mariners 7-0 on Sunday to complete a three-game sweep.
headlines.shortLinkText: Scherzer fans 10 for first win since March, Blue Jays blank Mariners 7-0 to complete sweep

events.name: Kansas City Royals at Cleveland Guardians

headlines.description: — José Ramírez homered, hit his 1,000th career single and drove in four while Parker Messick struck out five and gave up one run in six innings to lead the Cleveland Guardians past the Kansas City Royals 11-1 on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: José Ramírez hits home run and 1,000th career single to help Guardians route Royals 11-1

events.name: Los Angeles Dodgers at Detroit Tigers

headlines.description: — Tyler Glasnow gave up two hits and one run in seven innings and Freddie Freeman scored three runs as the Los Angeles Dodgers beat the Detroit Tigers 6-1 on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Glasnow goes 7 innings to lead Dodgers to 6-1 win over Tigers

events.name: San Diego Padres at Tampa Bay Rays

headlines.description: — Jonny DeLuca hit a two-out, two-run homer off Mason Miller to tie it in the ninth inning and Jorge Mateo singled in the winning run in the 11th as the Tampa Bay Rays beat the San Diego Padres 5-4 on Sunday to finish a three-game sweep.
headlines.shortLinkText: Jonny DeLuca's homer ties game in ninth, Jorge Mateo wins it for Rays in 11th in 5-4 win over Padres

events.name: Chicago White Sox at Minnesota Twins

headlines.description: — Zebby Matthews took a perfect game into the sixth inning and pitched a career-high 8 1/3 innings as the Minnesota Twins beat the Chicago White Sox 5-1 on Sunday to avoid being swept by the American League Central leaders.
headlines.shortLinkText: Zebby Matthews finishes stellar August as Twins beat White Sox 5-1

headlines.description: — Ezequiel Durán homered, doubled and drove in three runs to help the Texas Rangers avoid a sweep by beating the Milwaukee Brewers 7-4 on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Ezequiel Durán leads the way as Rangers snap 4-game skid by beating Brewers 7-4

events.name: Pittsburgh Pirates at St. Louis Cardinals

headlines.description: — Esmerlyn Valdez and Jared Triolo homered, Brandon Lowe added an RBI single and the Pittsburgh Pirates beat the St. Louis Cardinals 5-4 on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Esmerlyn Valdez and Jared Triolo homer in Pirates' 5-4 win over Cardinals

events.name: Houston Astros at New York Mets

headlines.description: — Pinch-hitter LaMonte Wade Jr.'s go-ahead two-run homer in the sixth inning helped power the Houston Astros to a 6-3 win over the New York Mets on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Wade's pinch-hit homer helps first-place Astros power past Mets 6-3

headlines.description: — Gunnar Henderson hit two homers and drove in five runs, Coby Mayo hit a three-run homer, and the Baltimore Orioles scored seven unanswered runs to rally past the Athletics 8-5 on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Henderson hits 2 homers, Orioles score 7 unanswered runs to rally past Athletics 8-5

events.name: Philadelphia Phillies at Los Angeles Angels

headlines.description: — Zack Wheeler allowed one run in six strong innings, Edmundo Sosa hit a tiebreaking homer in the seventh and the Philadelphia Phillies completed a three-game sweep with a 5-2 win over the Los Angeles Angels on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Wheeler throws 6 strong innings, Sosa hits go-ahead homer in Phillies' 5-2 win over Angels

headlines.description: — Rookie Sal Stewart homered for the third straight game to help offset two more home runs by Pete Crow-Armstrong, and the Cincinnati Reds beat the Chicago Cubs 7-5 on Sunday night after rain delayed the start 25 minutes.
headlines.shortLinkText: Rookie Sal Stewart homers for the 3rd straight game, helping the Reds beat the Cubs 7-5
